# zerocopy

Shared immutable collections. Reads are local; tasks are optional.

Source: https://github.com/natanelia/zerocopy/commit/23b3c5a560ef1fc0469ffb274b7f6f36e1a58ee5

- [Get started with shared state and Web Workers](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/getting-started.md): Set up zerocopy in JavaScript or TypeScript. Share immutable state with a Web Worker using SharedArrayBuffer and read locally on both threads.
- [How sharing works](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/mental-model.md): One writer, immutable snapshots, and local reads. A model you can reason about.
- [Immutable collections API & types](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/collections.md): zerocopy API reference for shared immutable maps, lists, sets, typed JSON, and nested collections in JavaScript and TypeScript.
- [Search shared text](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/text-search.md): Match UTF-8 text locally without decoding every row. Exact literal search and stable snapshots.
- [State & subscriptions](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/sessions.md): Connect workers and publish new snapshots without a task system.
- [Your own transport](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/transport.md): Use shared snapshots with an existing message protocol.
- [Optional tasks](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/tasks.md): Schedule a whole calculation. Keep individual reads local.
- [Worker tasks & pools](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/workers.md): Run typed tasks with zerocopy in Web Workers and Node.js worker threads. Use worker pools, MessagePorts, and SharedWorker connections.
- [Redux & Redux Toolkit integration](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/redux.md): Keep your Redux store and share selected immutable collections with workers. Connect zerocopy to Redux Toolkit, selectors, and DevTools.
- [TanStack DB integration](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/tanstack.md): Use zerocopy collection wrappers and sync-cache helpers with TanStack DB. Examples, adapter behavior, and current limits.
- [Memory & ownership](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/memory.md): Understand storage, retained snapshots, and explicit compaction.
- [Memory comparison](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/memory-comparison.md): Measured worker memory, shared buffer accounting, reader scaling, retained snapshots and process RAM.
- [Recorded benchmarks](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/benchmarks.md): All recorded results, slower workloads, and methods. No selected-only results.
- [Migration](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/migration.md): Format and lifetime changes for existing users.
- [Choose a use case](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/use-cases.md): Where sharing helps, where it does not, and which alternatives to consider.
- [Live log explorer](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/log-explorer.md): One working example: search, summarize, and inspect a large shared stream.
- [Large tables & dashboards](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/data-tables.md): Multiple independent views of the same large, changing table.
- [Graphs & developer tools](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/graphs.md): Stable versions for traversal, layout, and diagnostics.
- [Simulation & world state](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/simulations.md): Separate simulation ownership from analysis and rendering.
- [Product catalogs & filtering](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/analytics.md): Read stock directly and filter a large catalog in workers.
- [Maps & spatial tools](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/maps.md): Keep the map editable while workers inspect its data.
- [Editors & history](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-28/e9cd24989586a3f3ec007f354c8cb76bd65a3042/markdown/editors.md): Read an earlier version without stopping new edits.
